wildlands.name: Wildlands
wildlands.description: Explore a changing wilderness, manage supplies, and overcome environmental challenges. Remember landmarks, resources, and past discoveries to plan your next move.
wildlands.alt: Wildlands: forested cliffs, mountain landmarks, and turquoise water viewed from above the valley.

skylands.name: Skylands
skylands.description: Traverse floating islands, surface landscapes, and underground depths. Build crossings, transport cargo, and reuse earlier discoveries to complete journeys across all three layers.
skylands.scope: Cover: Aster Reach introductory construction course, full-size variant, seed 7.
skylands.alt: Skylands: a traveler faces a construction gap between floating islands, framed by golden trees and a ruined arch.
